options.text: Critics however contend that such a program would be too expensive and could discourage work.
Critics, however contend that such a program would be too expensive, and could discourage work.
Critics, however, contend that such a program would be too expensive and could discourage work.
Critics however, contend that such a program would be too expensive and could discourage work.

deep_analysis.explanation: The underlined portion includes a contrasting idea introduced by "however." The correct punctuation requires a comma after "however" to set off the contrasting clause. Option C correctly places the comma after "however" and maintains the flow of the sentence.
